subject: BrightRetail eval — integration & success criteria
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ethan Miller <ethan.miller@brightretail.com>, Priya Sharma <priya.sharma@brightretail.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 03 Apr 2027 17:12:00 -0700
Subject: BrightRetail eval — integration & success criteria

Hi Ethan / Priya —

Thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have a single source of truth for the trial kickoff. I pulled notes from our conversation and added a proposed technical approach beneath each success criterion. Please reply with any changes or confirm and we’ll schedule the kickoff sprint.

1) High-level scope
- Goal: 2-week hosted evaluation that demonstrates: (a) reliable product tagging and assisted search suggestions for product catalog pages, and (b) a reranking endpoint for search results using embeddings + rerank model.
- Redwood deliverables: sandbox API keys, a short SDK integration guide for JS/Python, a base evaluation harness (sample prompt/queries), and instrumentation for latency/cost.

2) Success criteria (BrightRetail to validate)
- Retrieval/rerank: reranked results show >10% CTR uplift in internal A/B on 1K seeded queries (sample set to be provided).
- Latency: p50 < 350ms and p95 < 1.2s for typical 128–512 token responses under expected trial concurrency (baseline 30 rps).
- Stability: zero request errors >1% over a 72-hour window during the trial window.
- Cost: projected per-1000-query inference cost below $X (we'll estimate after model choice).

3) Technical integration plan (high level)
- Auth: API keys (Authorization: Bearer <token>).
- Routes: use /v1/embeddings for embedding requests; /v1/rerank for reranker (we’ll provide a lightweight shim); /v1/generate (chat endpoint) for any assistant flows.
- Streaming: we recommend streaming (SSE) for long assistant responses on product detail pages. SDKs will include streaming examples.
- Tool calling: if BrightRetail wants to use structured tool calls (inventory lookup, price checks), we’ll enable function_call in the chat API and show examples in the SDK.
- Caching/Batching: enable prefix KV cache for product description prompts and a batching size of up to 8 for embedding requests to reduce cost.

4) Owners & timeline (proposed)
- Week 0 (this week): sign trial SOW (Sean) and share sample query set (BrightRetail: Ethan).
- Week 1: sandbox keys + SDK snippets (Tessa); initial integration & smoke tests (BrightRetail eng: Priya).
- Week 2: run evaluation harness, collect metrics, adjust batching/quant profiles (Laura + BrightRetail eng).
- Week 3: results review and decision point (success/follow-on pilot).

Attachments: I attached a mutual action plan (MAP) and a short API checklist. I’ll also put the MAP in the shared Drive.

Next steps: please confirm: (A) success criteria above, (B) Priya as technical owner for integration, (C) SOW approval to start sandbox keys.

Best,

Tessa Morgan
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Tessa — thanks for the clear recap. Confirming a few points from our side and adding a couple of constraints.

- Confirmed: Priya will be the technical lead for the trial (she’s cc’d). She will own integration and run the eval harness.
- Success criteria: the CTR uplift target looks good, but engineering asked that we add a qualitative relevance check (sample of 200 queries reviewed by merchandising team with at least 85% relevance rating).
- Latency: the p95 threshold is OK but we should try to target p50 < 300ms if feasible; we’ll rely on the baseline 30 rps.
- Data residency: Can you confirm sandbox logs will be retained in US only? We have a compliance checkbox for that.

Technical note (from Priya): our catalog pages already call a server-side Node service. We prefer Redwood’s JS SDK and SSE streaming for product assistant, and a thin server-side call for embeddings/rerank. Priya will share our sample product catalog extract by Wed 7 Apr.

We’re good to sign a 3-week trial SOW if Sean can confirm the trial credit + contract terms.

—Ethan

Ethan / Priya — great, thanks for confirming. A few technical details and concrete artifacts attached to unblock Priya: 

1) SDK & sample snippets (attached in API_integration_checklist.md)
- JS (Node + browser) and Python examples for: authentication, embeddings (/v1/embeddings), rerank (/v1/rerank), chat streaming (/v1/generate with SSE), and function_call payload examples.

2) Streaming example (SSE)
- Endpoint: POST /v1/generate?model=redwood-embedder-rlr
- Headers: Authorization: Bearer <SANDBOX_KEY>
- Body (JSON): {"messages": [{"role":"user","content":"Suggest 3 related accessories for SKU:1234"}], "stream": true, "tool_calling": false}
- SSE format emits token events; SDK will rehydrate tokens and call onToken callbacks.

3) Function calling example (Node)
- Use function_call: {"name":"getInventory","arguments_schema": {"type":"object","properties":{"sku":{"type":"string"}}}}
- Redwood will POST to your signed webhook URL with a signed HMAC header x-rw-signature. We’ll include a short verification utility in the SDK.

4) Rerank shim
- We provide a small rerank service (container image) you can run in dev. Calls: POST /v1/rerank with body {"query": "...", "candidates": ["..."], "top_k": 10}. Returns scores and reordered list.

5) KV cache recommendations
- Cache stable product descriptions for 24h; warm the KV on catalog sync jobs. This reduces token counts for many PD prompts.

Attachments: API_integration_checklist.md (samples), trial_sow_draft.pdf (SOW template). I also uploaded the MAP to the Drive link above.

Proposed timeline update: Priya to share sample catalog by EOD Wed 7 Apr; Tessa to provision sandbox keys by Thu 8 Apr; integration smoke tests Thu–Fri; run evaluation harness Mon–Tue next week.
